sources: Hits, frames, keys, stagger, finisher factors, physical statuses and energy: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0018_dapan_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0018_dapan_* as compiled by efsim kit-draft (2026-10-20), plus what it leaves out (talents' attached buffs and their triggers, P5's interval marker). Values at the build's levels from SkillPatchTable and PotentialTalentEffectTable. Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0018_dapan.md, § Mechanics, § Kit plan and § Kit (2026-10-20).

Timing from SkillData (the loader): exclusive frames (battle 65, combo 52, ultimate 100), recast and chain windows, the ultimate's time stop (layer-0 TimeDilationAction at scale 0, frames 0–36, ignoring Da Pan) and the combo's ComboSkill slow-down (0–15).

Vulnerable: the battle skill's Lift (not forced: on an enemy without Vulnerable it only adds a stack), the ultimate's forced Lift (frame 0) and forced Knock Down (frame 80) each add one; the combo's Crush consumes them all (status.ts). Talent 1 and Ancient Canal hang on that consumption (the physicalStatus event's level is the stacks consumed).

Not modelled: P1 ("If the ultimate defeats at least one enemy": kills, batch 3 N2, deferred; its buff buff_chr_0018_dapan_potential_1 would be a kill trigger on the ultimate's frames 0–89); the enemy's interrupts (InterruptAction: enemy actions come only from the scenario); hit-stops (layer-1 dilation on each flurry tick); the immunity buffs; the combo's tutorial marker; the dash attack (skillSpecification 7, S5 deferred). P5's "hits only one enemy" always holds (one enemy).

buffs.label: Reduce and Thicken: Physical DMG per Vulnerable stack consumed
buffs.note: Talent 1 (PotentialTalentEffectTable attachBuff buff_chr_0018_dapan_talent_0: dmg_up 0.04 / 0.06 by talent level, stack 4, duration 10 s). BuffData buff_chr_0018_dapan_talent_0_dmg_up: attributeModifier attr 50 (Physical DMG) dmg_up; stackingType 8 (layers on one timer, which the loader shares and each layer refreshes: batch 3 B3, in-game test 62).

buffs.label: Salty or Mild: Prep Ingredients
buffs.note: Talent 2: the ultimate's frame-80 ForEach target CreateBuff (only if talent_1 ≥ 1) assigns talent_1_duration (20 s; +10 at P2) and talent_1_stack (1 / 2 by talent level; +1 at P2) as its duration and max_stack. stackingType 8. One enemy: one layer per ultimate.

buffs.label: P5: extra Vulnerable used (45 s)
buffs.note: The battle skill's CreateTimedMarker potential_5_interval (45 s at P5; 0 below, where the IfElse's CompareFloat potential_5_interval ≥ 1 fails and the marker is never made).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable chr_0018_dapan_ComboSkill: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy reaches 4 stacks of Vulnerability." (game code: no TriggerComboSkillAction in the data). Anyone's stacks ("an enemy reaches"). Interim (report row 13, in-game test 64): a stack added at 4 (the count stays 4) opens the window again; if the test says only 3 → 4 opens it, add rising: true (batch 3 T1).
Frame 0: AirborneAction forceAirborne ("slams the chopping board to forcibly Lift all enemies"), no damage landing there (as compiled by kit-draft).

buff_chr_0018_dapan_talent_0: abilityEvent 208 (Da Pan consumes a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContextAdvanced buff_physical_no_guard + CheckConsumeBuffLayer (≥ 1, consumedLayer) → CreateBuff _dmg_up × consumedLayer: one layer per Vulnerable stack consumed. Crush and Breach are what consume Vulnerable; the event's level is the stacks consumed. beforeDamage: in buff_physical_do_crushed the FinishBuff of Vulnerable runs before the Crush's DamageAction, and the CrushAction before the combo's (in-game test 51, Da Pan part).

buff_chr_0018_dapan_talent_1_preparation: on a combo cast (abilityEvent 30, CheckSkillType [6]) → buff _cd_reduce, which on Da Pan's next damage (abilityEvent 13) runs SetSkillCdAtOnce isPercentage cd_reduce (talent_1_cd_reduce 0.4) on skillTypeMask 64 (combo), ends 1 layer of Prep Ingredients and itself. "Shortens cooldown by 40%" read as 40% of the full cooldown (in-game test 36, Da Pan part).
